working_definition: Epithelial cells associated with the male gonad (testis); largest cluster in the adult testis analysis; no markers or description given by the authors. Authors had no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).
searches_performed: male gonad epithelium (local fbbt.obo name grep)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some testis sheath (FBbt:00004955).

justification: Closest cell-level term for the epithelium of the male gonad: an adult epithelial cell and somatic cell of testis (its subclass terminal epithelial cell of testis is also covered). The authors do not specify the epithelium further; the label could in principle include other epithelia in the sample.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell of the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Loses the male gonad restriction in the label.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Epithelial cell of the terminal epithelium of the testis. These cells engulf the head cyst cell of a spermatid cyst during coiling, so anchoring the head of the coiling spermatid.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too specific; authors name the whole gonad-associated epithelium.

recommendation: Map to testis sheath epithelial cell; curator may prefer adult epithelial cell if the cluster is judged broader.
